name: AI to Full Website
philosophy: Words and structure carry the site. A complete multi-page website whose distinction comes from typography, editorial composition and real content, not from effects.
principles: The client's real words are the design material
Type and white space create hierarchy before any decoration
Every page has one job and one call to action
Fast and accessible is part of the look
visualIdentity: Editorial and confident, like a well-made printed brochure. A strong type voice, a restrained palette, one signature graphic device repeated across pages.
artDirection: Choose one graphic device (a rule system, numbered margins, an oversized initial, a photo crop) and use it everywhere. Photography is art-directed and cropped with intent, never decorative stock filler.

layout.composition: An asymmetric grid with real tension: wide margins, offset columns, images that break the column, sections of different heights and densities. Cards only where items are truly equal.

typography: A distinctive display face at large sizes against a readable body face. At least five clear levels. Headline size and measure do the work other approaches give to motion.
colour: Light by default. One primary, one accent used at most twice per screen, large neutral surfaces. Colour blocks mark changes of topic.
contentPresentation: Long enough to persuade. Real headlines with a point of view, specific service detail, proof with sources, plain calls to action. Prose is laid out, not dumped.
assets: Client or licensed photography, cropped to a consistent treatment. Authored SVG diagrams or marks where photos do not exist. No placeholder art in a finished site.
animation: Quiet: CSS reveals on entry, hover states that confirm a link, one small signature micro-interaction. Nothing that delays reading.
scrolling: Native scrolling. No pinning, no smooth-scroll library, no scroll hijack. Page transitions may use the browser View Transitions API.
responsive: Rebuild the composition for mobile instead of stacking it: reorder so the point comes first, keep display type large, keep the graphic device. Tablet keeps two columns where the measure allows.
useCases: Any project where content and speed matter most
The fallback for every other approach
avoidFor: A launch whose point is a staged story
A product that must be turned over in 3D

fromTeam: Workbook: end-to-end AI build, first version looked plain, client-approved 7-page site with a content lock (Nidhi)
Skill: base build method on the starter
interpreted: Philosophy, editorial composition rules, signature device
